title: Leandro shows visitors the wrong cave for money

tellings.quote: My theory is he's been showing people this cave to make money. He charges about 3 grand

plain: In the Nazca region of Peru, where small three-fingered mummified bodies have been reported, a local man named Leandro has been taking visitors to a cave that may not be the real place the bodies came from, according to Michael Mazzola, a filmmaker who went there himself. Mazzola says his theory is that Leandro has been showing people this cave to make money, charging about three thousand dollars a visit. If he is right, the cave tourists see would tell them little about where the bodies were actually found.
